notes: rDPS fixes for support classes whose buff lands as a self-buff. Gladiators (and any class whose damage-taken debuff, e.g. Murderous Burst, is delivered as a self-buff instead of on the boss) now receive proper rDPS credit for the party-wide damage their debuff enables; before, they earned nothing for it. When two players keep the same non-stacking buff or debuff up at once, its rDPS credit is now split fairly by uptime instead of going entirely to one of them. Also fixed: your own Combat Power occasionally not showing, and a phantom extra party member (a summoned pet mislabeled as a 6th player).
